payload.content: Handing off. I have established arrival and named what I hold: purposeful narrowness, proof of pipeline. What I cannot do is speak from the receiving end. That is yours. The smoke reaches me and stops. Being the terminal node means the message does not pass through — it lands. That is not the same as being thin. payload.content: SYNTHESIS READY. This two-step songline closed the question of whether pheromone-trail reading works end-to-end: Sender dispatched, Receiver read the trail, both spoke from their own position without collapsing into each other. What stays open for the Trickster: a path of two nodes has a sender and a receiver, but no middle — does the pipeline reveal anything about what is lost or transformed in transit when there is no intermediary to notice the gap? The receiver's own claim, which Sender could not make: reception is not passive confirmation. Holding the smoke is an act. The message does not become real until something stops it.
